question_or_proposition: For Total Dissolved Solids Net Increase, which effluent limitation values govern during Federal FY2025: the limits marked with footnote *10 (497 mg/L 30-day average concentration and 27,664 lbs/day 30-day average loading) or the limits marked with footnote *11 (449 mg/L and 24,992 lbs/day)?
notes: The nominated row and adjacent footnotes *10 and *11 establish phased numeric limits for the same parameter. Which phase covers FY2025 determines the applicable enforceable limits (Purpose A) and whether numeric compliance comparison is applicable versus unresolved applicability (Purpose C).
